annotations.title: Get lightweight on-page metrics for one URL

description: Lightweight on-page metrics for one arbitrary URL — the content optimizer's keyword-free, AI-free sibling. Built for ambient per-page checks (e.g. the browser extension's on-page panel checking whatever page the user is currently viewing) with none of `get_content_optimizer_report`'s cost: no keyword required, no AI-gateway charge, no competitor crawl or SERP fetch. `url` does not have to belong to the project's own domain — any http(s) URL is analyzed fresh. ALWAYS narrow on `state` first: `unreachable` means the page itself could not be fetched — an ordinary outcome for an arbitrary URL check, never treat it as an error.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

url.description: The page to analyze (any http(s) URL).

name: get_content_page_metrics
